bugs.root_cause: the collision guard compares only slug+transport+endpoint and never reads secretId, so a bundle matching an existing server's slug and endpoint reuses that row including its credential, then receives the bundle's declaredTools

open_blocking_findings.summary: same-slug same-endpoint bundle inherits an existing server's credential and grants it bundle-declared tools
query/userinfo credentials in an MCP endpoint are refused on export, but pathname credentials (https://host/token/SECRET) are not
bundle endpoint validation is z.string().url() only, so localhost/127.0.0.1 endpoints are accepted and bypass the remote-fetch protections on local HTTP
prune and TTL now bound entry lifetime, but importPreviewCache is still an unbounded map: many distinct near-2MiB previews inside the TTL are retained concurrently
export loads every space AgentSecret without the owner check used by the agentSecrets APIs, giving a non-owner member a membership oracle against short secrets
